title: canon_corrections.md
content:
# Canon Corrections Enforced

- Dril'thar: exactly six bloodlines. Marsh absorbs Swamp and covers marshes, swamps, bogs, fens, and mixed wetlands. Every bloodline breathes underwater.
- Jaspey: Mosscap, Gloomtail, and Rotcap are non-bloodline forms/caste expressions.
- Kaluseban: six system-canonical bloodlines—Psionic, Swamp, Arcane, Dark, Stone, and Oceanic—with complete supplied mechanics mapped into those labels.
- Dragonborn: the nine project-specific ancestry choices are bloodlines.
- Deorbasun: Open Soul-Animal is an open-ended bloodline established by the first true soul bond.
- Sea Elf remains an Elf bloodline seed, not a separate parent race.
